# Approval workflow

The experience is designed for platform administrators who manage private registry content.
Administrators need to understand why an artifact is blocked so that they can resolve policy failures without opening a support ticket.
An administrator reviews a pending artifact, inspects the evidence, and approves it for publication.
The system must preserve an audit record for every approval decision.
This study should determine whether administrators can recover from a blocked artifact without assistance.
Which labels make the next action clear?
